# FiveOh Reviews on Metaobjects

> A Shopify-native display layer for product reviews and purchase signals. Keep your existing review app for collection, or collect reviews with FiveOh. Product reviews are stored in Shopify's standard product review metaobjects and rendered in your theme with Liquid.

FiveOh is for merchants, developers and agencies who want control over how reviews and purchase signals appear in a Shopify store.

1. **Rendering and performance:** Initial review content is rendered server-side in Liquid and included in the page HTML. Displaying it does not require the browser to fetch reviews from the source provider. This removes that loading dependency; the actual effect on loading times and layout stability depends on the theme and implementation.
2. **Design and placement:** App blocks include product ratings, product-card ratings, review lists, review sliders and rating bars. Developers can customise markup with structure templates and placeholder tokens, apply scoped CSS, or build Liquid sections around the stored review data.
3. **Import and sync:** Documented sources include Judge.me, Loox, REVIEWS.io, Trustpilot, Shop app reviews and CSV files. Setup and update methods vary by source. Trustpilot supports service and product reviews, product matching and full or incremental syncs. Existing Shop app reviews stored as standard review metaobjects are read and kept in sync; this is distinct from publishing reviews to other channels.
4. **Native collection:** FiveOh supports post-purchase review-request emails and storefront review forms. For logged-in customers, storefront forms attach the customer account and prefill the author name. Clearing the name keeps the displayed author anonymous. A customer account alone does not verify a purchase. Email templates and timing are configurable, and post-purchase review submissions can trigger Shopify discount rewards.
5. **Purchase signals:** Blocks can show units sold over a selected period, the latest purchase time, bestseller rank and returning-customer figures. Thresholds control when signals appear. Returning-customer figures describe customers returning to the store, not repeat purchases of the same product.
6. **Translations:** Review titles and bodies are automatically translated into the store's published languages. Translations use Shopify's native translation system and render for the shopper's locale. Older reviews may need reprocessing when a language is added.
7. **Search and AI readability:** Server-rendered review text and review structured data are available in the HTML for crawlers to read. This does not guarantee indexing, search-result stars, rankings or citations by AI tools.
8. **Data ownership:** Product reviews remain in Shopify's standard review metaobjects after uninstall. The stored data can be used by custom Liquid code or compatible tools; keeping the data is separate from keeping the app's storefront blocks.
9. **Fair pricing**: Free plan for up to 100 reviews with all features included. Paid plans scale affordably because Shopify handles the infrastructure, not us.
